## 🗺️ Course Roadmap & 12-Week Syllabus

Follows the official PHYC54 Fall 2026 syllabus taught by Prof. Johann Bayer. Weekly readings correspond to John R. Taylor's *Classical Mechanics* (2005).

| Week | Dates | Core Topics & Taylor Readings | Associated Tutorials & Milestones | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **01** | Sep. 08-10 | Calculus of Variations (Ch 6: 1–2) | Calculus of Variations (Ch 6: 3–4) | Complete |
| **02** | Sep. 15-17 | Lagrange's Equations (Ch 7: 1–4) | Problem Set #01 | In Progress |
| **03** | Sep. 22-24 | Lagrange's Equations (Ch 7: 5–8) | Problem Set #02 | Available |
| **04** | Sep. 29 - Oct. 01 | Hamiltonian Mechanics (Ch 13: 1–4) | Problem Set #03 | Upcoming |
| **05** | Oct. 06-08 | Hamiltonian Mechanics & Phase Space (Ch 13: 5–7) | Problem Set #04 (**Test #1**) | Upcoming |
| **06** | Oct. 13-15 | Mechanics in Noninertial Frames (Ch 9: 1–3) | Problem Set #05 | Upcoming |
| **07** | Oct. 20-22 | Mechanics in Noninertial Frames (Ch 9: 4–7) | Problem Set #06 | Upcoming |
| **RW** | Oct. 27-29 | **Reading Week** (No classes) | Problem Set #07 Review | Study Break |
| **08** | Nov. 03-05 | Mechanics in Noninertial Frames (Ch 9: 8–10) | Problem Set #08 | Upcoming |
| **09** | Nov. 10-12 | Rotational Motion of Rigid Bodies (Ch 10: 1–3) | Problem Set #09 (**Test #2**) | Upcoming |
| **10** | Nov. 17-19 | Rotational Motion of Rigid Bodies (Ch 10: 4–7) | Problem Set #10 | Upcoming |
| **11** | Nov. 24-26 | Rotational Motion of Rigid Bodies (Ch 10: 8–10) | Problem Set #11 | Upcoming |
| **12** | Dec. 01-03 | Continuum Mechanics (Ch 16: 1–4) | Problem Set #12 | Upcoming |
| **Final** | Dec. 10-22 | **Comprehensive Final Examination** | Dec. 10–22 Exam Period | Scheduled |
